SELECT r.reservation_id , r.user_id , r.fair_id , r.visit_date , r.reservation_type , r.status AS reservation_status , p.status AS payment_status , rf.status AS refund_status , rf.refund_id , rf.refund_amount FROM fairs f JOIN reservations r ON r.fair_id = f.fair_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id AND p.payment_type = 'RESERVATION_DEPOSIT' LEFT JOIN refund rf ON rf.payment_id = p.payment_id WHERE f.canceled_at IS NOT NULL
AND r.status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CONFIRMED') ORDER BY r.reservation_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF r SKIP LOCKED
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_histories ( reservation_id , action_type , before_data , after_data , changed_by , actor_type , is_admin_action , change_reason , created_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationId} , 'FAIR_CANCELED' , JSON_OBJECT('status', #{previousStatus}) , JSON_OBJECT( 'status', 'CANCELED', 'refundId', #{refundId}, 'refundAmount', #{refundAmount} ) , NULL , 'SYSTEM' , FALSE , #{reason} , #{now} )
